items.title: 编写 Authority session 与 receipt-backed gate 执行文档
items.context: 产出 docs/requirements/decisions/authority-session-receipt-gate-execution.md，说明 session ID 只是 identity 字段，必须绑定到 job/evidence envelope/receipt/gate predicate 才算强证据链路；文档需要覆盖 server、runner、CLI、cross-repo validation 四层职责和 phased rollout。
items.userSees: User opens docs/requirements/decisions/authority-session-receipt-gate-execution.md and sees "Authority session identity lifecycle + receipt-backed gate consumption" plus sections for "Execution streams", "Receipt-backed gate predicate", "Phased rollout", and "Fail-closed validation".

happy.desc: The execution document defines the end-to-end strong-evidence rollout across Python Authority Server, runner host, Lattice CLI, and cross-repo validation with clear deliverables and prerequisites.

edge.desc: The document distinguishes local Lattice sessions and KOALA_AUTHORITY_SESSION_ID/readiness presence from receipt-backed Authority runner identity; it does not claim sessionConfigured=true is sufficient.

adversarial.desc: The document rejects overclaim paths: transport accepted, local receipt, fake server, readiness status, or report prose cannot set productionDone/receiptVerified/strongEvidenceConsumed without a verified AuthorityReceipt consumed by gate predicates.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e docs check for required execution streams and rollout sections
verificationEvidence.note: The document contains the title, Execution streams, Phased rollout, and role/prerequisite tables that define the end-to-end strong-evidence rollout across Python Authority Server, runner host, Lattice CLI, and cross-repo validation.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e docs check for session presence vs binding wording
verificationEvidence.note: The document states KOALA_AUTHORITY_SESSION_ID is presence detection only and separately requires the session id to be bound into the Authority job/evidence path before it matters to gates.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e docs check for overclaim rejection wording
verificationEvidence.note: The document rejects transport accepted, fake/local receipts, and prose-only pass claims; it says strongEvidenceConsumed=true is derived only from verified receipt refs consumed by gate predicates.
